blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The issuer's mTBILL source inherits mToken and defines M_TBILL_PAUSE_OPERATOR_ROLE. mToken implements role-gated pause/unpause and calls _onlyNotBlacklisted() for both sender and recipient on transfers. October 1 pinned reads confirmed the recorded mTBILL identities, decimals, access-control addresses, and mint-role constant on the five listed native deployments. The capability is supported by product source, not inferred solely from centralized governance.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: October 1 pinned reads confirm mTBILL token identities and EIP-1967 proxy paths on Ethereum, Base, Rootstock, Plume and Etherlink. The issuer-listed issuance vaults hold M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE on Ethereum, Base, Rootstock and Etherlink; the listed Plume vault does not hold that role at block 96626537. These reads do not establish an exhaustive minter census or exclude additional cross-chain adapters. The issuer contracts repository contains LayerZero and Axelar integrations, but their deployment-specific mTBILL use is not established by this review.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-2 (lead usdc-circle)
